---
title: "distributions"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(janitor)
set.seed(42)
```
```{r}
fish <- read_csv("data/fish.csv") |> clean_names()
geo <- fish |> filter (genus == "Geotria")
ggplot(geo, aes(x = total_length_cm)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  ggtitle("Distribution of total length in Geotria") +
  xlab("Total length (cm)") +
  ylab("Number of fish") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot (geo, aes(
  x=total_length_cm
)) + 
  geom_histogram(aes(y=after_stat(density)),
            bins = 30
            )+
  ggtitle("distribution of total length in Geotria fish") +
  xlab("total lengh (cm)")+
  ylab("Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Calculate the observed mean and standard deviation
mean_obs <- mean(pull(geo, total_length_cm))
sd_obs <- sd(pull(geo, total_length_cm))

# Draw the plot
ggplot(geo, aes(
  x = total_length_cm
)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)),
    bins = 50
  ) +
  stat_function(
    fun = dnorm,
    args = list(mean = mean_obs, sd = sd_obs)
  ) +
  ggtitle("Distribution of total length in Geotria fish  -\nObserved and Theoretical") +
  xlab("Total length (cm)") +
  ylab("Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```
